caption:
Investment giant Apollo says normal companies are seeing zero financial payoff from AI. While big tech is cashing in, the rest of corporate America is treating AI spending as a boring cost rather than a money printer. Are your bosses still forcing you to use AI for everything? 🤖📉

What is the most pointless way your office has tried to use AI so far?

Source: Business Insider

#ArtificialIntelligence #TechTrends #MarketingStrategy #CreatorEconomy #BusinessNews

post.news: Investment firm Apollo Global Management says AI has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of the tech industry.
post.take: We spent billions on a magic robot that basically just helps us write better emails about why we have no money.
post.insight: Every major tech shift eventually has to prove it makes money for normal businesses, not just the people selling the tools.
